name: Aashka Hospitals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Aashka Hospitals Ltd operates Multi Disciplinary Private Hospital, Clinics, and Pharmacies[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) AHL is a Multi - Speciality hospital located in Gandhinagar, consisting of 150 beds including 65 ICU beds, class 100 modular 2 cardiac OTs & 4 OTs for each & every super – specialty. 
b) 2 procedure rooms are available for endoscopy and other procedures
c) All OTs are fitted with laminar airflow, HEPA filters & next generation Anesthesia trolley
d) Hospital has flat panel Cath Lab, CT scan, pneumatic transfer system & software driven administration
e) Company's Ultra-modern 65 bedded
 ICU are equipped with intelligent ventilators, by-phasic AED & pacing defibrillators, modular touch screen multipara monitoring system and centralized Gas supply system

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -3.62% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.74% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.10 Cr.
